toast.databaseUnavailable: Couldn't open the database. The queue and progress won't be saved this time.
toast.queueUnreadable: Couldn't restore the last queue. A copy has been kept.

playback.network: No internet, so “${title}” can’t play. Your library and queue still work.
playback.rateLimited: ${source} is limiting requests. “${title}” can’t play right now.
playback.credentialInvalid: Your ${source} login has expired, so “${title}” can’t play.
playback.verificationRequired: ${source} wants you to verify before playback can continue.
playback.trialOnly: Only a preview of “${title}” is available.
playback.notFound: Couldn’t find “${title}”. It may have been deleted.
playback.parseFailure: “${title}” can’t play: ${source} sent a response FMP doesn’t understand.
playback.sourceUnsupported: ${source} doesn’t support playback, so “${title}” can’t play.
playback.formatUnsupported: This device can’t play the format of “${title}”.
playback.stopped: ${count} tracks in a row couldn’t play, so playback stopped. ${reason}

message(plural, param=count).one: This removes the track from the queue and stops playback. Playlists aren’t affected.
message(plural, param=count).other: This removes all $count tracks from the queue and stops playback. Playlists aren’t affected.

empty.title: The queue is empty
empty.body: Add tracks from search or a playlist and they’ll line up here

end.off: Repeat is off: playback stops after the last track
end.all: Repeat All is on: after the last track, back to track 1
end.allShuffled: Repeat All is on: after the last track, back to track 1, reshuffled
end.one: Repeat One is on: the playing track keeps repeating

temporary.title: Temporary play
temporary.returnTouch(rich): When it ends or you skip, back to #$number below, “$title”, from $position ($seconds s earlier)
temporary.returnTable(rich): When it ends or you press Previous or Next, back to #$number below, “$title”, from $position ($seconds s earlier)

error.title: Can't search $source right now
error.rateLimited: Too many requests; $source is rate limiting us.
error.loginRequired: Sign in to search this source.
error.othersShown: Other sources are shown as usual.

empty.title: No results for “$query”
empty.body: No matching tracks. Try fewer keywords, or check the spelling.

actions.playHint: Play now, leave the queue as is
actions.addToQueueHint: At the end of the queue
